cleaning_decisions.duplicates: Keep the richest record for each (OSM type, OSM ID).
cleaning_decisions.missing_names: Preserve valid unnamed stops as null.
cleaning_decisions.missing_route_metadata: Do not infer missing ref, operator, from, or to values.
cleaning_decisions.route_geometry: Unlabelled route relation members are treated as geometry, not stops.
cleaning_decisions.routes: Retain route relations whose route mode is bus or ferry.
cleaning_decisions.stops: Retain tagged transit stops plus objects explicitly referenced using stop/platform route-member roles.
